source: Rule-based detector on MEASURED NISAR + Sentinel-1 water areas (this project)
method: harmonised area vs 21-day multi-sensor baseline; WARNING < -12%, ALERT < -20%, each confirmed by an independent pass within 6 days (03_anomaly.departure_rule, unchanged)
uncertainty: σ of departures 3.2% over the whole series. No reference event is known for this dam: flags are monitoring prompts for an operator, not validated detections. rule.sigma_per_sqrt_day carries the departure σ (not per √day).
